title: Casper and the Hymn
author: Bram Marchetti
blurb: Lior Galloway, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
